build_alexnet_backbone: build an AlexNet backbone model with configurable number of classes for image feature extraction
create_alexnet_classifier: create an AlexNet model with a classifier head for N-class image classification tasks
run_alexnet_forward: run a forward pass through the AlexNet model on a batch of input images
init_alexnet_weights: initialize AlexNet model weights from a pretrained checkpoint file path
review_alexnet_architecture: review the AlexNet convolutional feature layers and classifier sequential architecture
